focus: Chicago (Loop, Near North, North Side, and West Loop)
intro: This first Chicago page covers private mailbox stores in the city — mostly the Loop, River North, the Near North Side, Lincoln Park, Lakeview, and the West Loop, plus a few independent stores on the North and Northwest Sides — whose own public pages list an address, staffed hours, and package acceptance. It is not a complete metro inventory. 24-hour lobby access is flagged only when the store’s own page says so. The UPS Store pages mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for those stores. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: MY MAIL CENTER
listings.address: 332 S Michigan Ave STE 121, Chicago, IL 60604

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the week of November 18, 2026, as shown on the mailbox rental page. The same page says mailbox customers have 24-hour access to a lit, secured mailbox area.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailbox rental page says the store accepts packages and mail from the Post Office, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and couriers.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox rental page claims 24-hour access to the mailbox area. It does not say whether packages too large for a box can be picked up after staffed hours. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
